title: Tenses Architecture & Time Markers
description: Sabhi 12 tense structures (3 Times × 4 Aspects), auxiliary verb ke rules, affirmative/negative/interrogative patterns aur contextual time markers ko master karein.
learningObjectives: Time aur Aspect ke dual-axis tense matrix ko achhe se samajhna
Sabhi 12 tenses ke structural formulas aur auxiliary verbs par pakad banana
Sentence mein correct tense choose karne ke liye contextual time markers pehchanna
Simple Past vs Present Perfect aur baaki confusing pairs ke beech ka difference samajhna
Positive, negative aur interrogative sentences accurately construct karna
